summary: Modular monolith: ASP.NET Core + Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL serving Vue + Vite (SPA), hosted on Google Cloud Run (us-central1 Iowa). Estimated $19-90/month (within the $200 budget).

architecture_rationale.text: One deployable with strict internal modules for the saas_b2b domain: a 5-engineer team gets clear boundaries without distributed-system overhead; modules can be extracted later if scale demands it. Over-engineering guard: microservices rejected: 5 engineer(s), no DevOps cannot absorb the operational overhead.

frontend.justification: Web - Vue + Vite (SPA): Chosen because team already works in javascript (team.languages); strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=3; rich client-side interactivity for a saas_b2b; strong maintainability (4/5) with priorities.maintainability=3.

alternatives.why_not: Vue + Vite scores higher on learning curve (fit 6.7 vs 7.0).
Vue + Vite scores higher on cost and operational simplicity (fit 6.5 vs 7.0).

backend.justification: Chosen because team already works in csharp (team.languages); strong maintainability (5/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; strong performance (5/5) with priorities.performance=3; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=3.

alternatives.why_not: ASP.NET Core scores higher on performance and scalability (fit 6.8 vs 8.6).
A saas_b2b domain needs a structured service, not scattered functions. ASP.NET Core scores higher on maintainability and performance (fit 6.5 vs 8.6).

warnings.message: 'MongoDB Realm Device Sync' matches MongoDB Atlas Device Sync / Realm Sync, end of life since 2025-09-30. It is not recommended; migrate to PowerSync or a custom SQLite sync. Unsupported software breaks patch-management controls required by the listed compliance regimes.

'MySQL 5.7' matches MySQL 5.7, end of life since 2023-10-31. It is not recommended; migrate to MySQL 8.4 LTS. Unsupported software breaks patch-management controls required by the listed compliance regimes.

'Node.js 16 API' matches Node.js 14/16/18, end of life since 2025-04-30. It is not recommended; migrate to Node.js 24 LTS. Unsupported software breaks patch-management controls required by the listed compliance regimes.

'Visual Studio App Center' matches Visual Studio App Center, end of life since 2025-03-31. It is not recommended; migrate to EAS / Codemagic / GitHub Actions + fastlane. Unsupported software breaks patch-management controls required by the listed compliance regimes.

'Xamarin mobile app' matches Xamarin, end of life since 2024-05-01. It is not recommended; migrate to .NET MAUI. Unsupported software breaks patch-management controls required by the listed compliance regimes.

'Heroku (current hosting)' (Heroku): Sustaining-engineering model: no new features, Enterprise sales stopped for new customers. Not used in the recommendation; alternative: Render / DigitalOcean / Cloud Run / ECS.
ISO 27001/SOC 2 certify your controls, not the stack: providers with attestations were chosen so you inherit their controls, but you still need policies, access reviews and audits.
'MongoDB Realm Device Sync': reused/migrated into PostgreSQL.
